record.paper_title: Some open problems in computational algebraic geometry
record.original_question: For algebraic curves of genus g <= 10 over fields of positive characteristic, determine the complete list of finite groups that occur as full automorphism groups.

evidence.quote: Let X denote a smooth, genus g algebraic curve defined over k, char k = p > 0.
Problem 8. Determine the list of groups which occur as full automorphism groups for genus g <= 10 algebraic curves defined over a field of positive characteristic.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field of characteristic $p > 0$, and let $X$ be a smooth, projective, irreducible algebraic curve of genus $g$ defined over $k$. Let $\mathrm{Aut}_k(X)$ denote the full group of $k$-automorphisms of $X$ (equivalently, the group of automorphisms of the function field $k(X)$ fixing $k$ pointwise); for $g \geq 2$ this group is finite.

Problem: For each $g$ with $2 \leq g \leq 10$ and each prime $p > 0$, determine the complete list (up to isomorphism) of finite groups $G$ that arise as $G \cong \mathrm{Aut}_k(X)$ for some such curve $X$ of genus $g$ over a field of characteristic $p$.
artifact.category_tag: automorphism groups of curves in positive characteristic
artifact.status_search_result: No complete classification of full automorphism groups of curves of genus 2 ≤ g ≤ 10 over fields of positive characteristic appears in the literature. While general bounds (Stichtenoth, Henn, Nakajima) and partial results for specific genera (notably g = 2, 3) are known, and the LMFDB lists automorphism groups in characteristic 0, a full list across all positive characteristics for g ≤ 10 is not available. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: On automorphisms of algebraic curves
status_evidence.snippet: Survey describing partial results and bounds (Stichtenoth, Henn, Nakajima) on automorphism groups of curves in positive characteristic; complete classification for small genus is only partial.
status_evidence.claim: A complete classification across all positive characteristics for small genera is not given; only partial results and bounds exist.

status_evidence.title: LMFDB - Families of higher genus curves with automorphisms
status_evidence.snippet: Database lists automorphism groups of curves of genus 2–15 over the complex numbers.
status_evidence.claim: Existing systematic databases cover characteristic 0 rather than positive characteristic.

status_evidence.title: Automorphism groups of algebraic curves in positive characteristic
status_evidence.snippet: Research talk on the subject indicates ongoing investigation.
status_evidence.claim: The classification problem in positive characteristic continues to be an active area of research.
